summary: Prevent material continuations from adding a downward science frontier.
details: When early material research already needs space, planetary or a concretely gated late mod science, continuation reuses the shared progression policy instead of adding a lower ordinary pack. The established space-first preference for earlier research and the pre-final useful continuation policy remain intact.

Inherited ingredients, amounts, IDs, admitted effects, caps, settings and cost anchors are preserved. Joint-lab and production checks still govern science. The final-pack escape remains when no ordinary or inherited late frontier is usable. Native save, progression and performance acceptance remain outstanding.
